annotation.title_clean: Reinvigorating Structured Knowledge and Ontologies for Trustworthy and Beneficial AI and Robotics
annotation.title_en: Reinvigorating Structured Knowledge and Ontologies for Trustworthy and Beneficial AI and Robotics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Chang, C.; Chen, Y.; Chen, Y.
annotation.venue: Frontiers in Artificial Intelligence and Applications, Vol. 409 (FOIS 2025), IOS Press
annotation.summary_en: Position paper arguing that formal ontology and structured knowledge research must be reinvigorated to keep pace with AI and robotics, so autonomous systems are transparent, accountable and beneficial. Only the abstract is available. It advocates ontology-augmented verification, semantic auditing and FAIR publishing of ontologies.
key_provisions_or_claims: Ontology research is under-resourced relative to AI and robotics, creating a semantic gap in system design and governance
Advocates ontology-augmented verification that adds semantic constraints to behavioral validation
Calls for institutionalized semantic auditing, with ontologies as inspectable system referents
Recommends FAIR publishing standards treating ontologies as first-class research outputs
Calls for renewed investment in ontology engineering and lower adoption barriers
